<thought>Based on the formula C8H14O, DBE = 2, one carbonyl, four methyl groups, and three sp² carbons (interpreted as “aromatic” in the data), the structure that fits is (CH₃)₃C‑CH=CH‑C(=O)‑CH₃. This can be split into two connectable fragments: the tert‑butyl group and the α,β‑unsaturated carbonyl fragment. The SMILES for these fragments are “CC(C)(C)C” and “C=CC(=O)C”.</thought>
<final_answer>['CC(C)(C)C', 'C=CC(=O)C']</final_answer>
